VDI Rationale / Note: CIS requires machine account password changes to stay enabled (0). VDI Rationale / Note: Machine inactivity limit is the last line of defence; the broker idle/disconnect timers should trigger first so the session is disconnected rather than just locked.

Policy Name: 2.3.7.4 Configure 'Interactive logon: Message text for users attempting to log on'
VDI Rationale / Note: A logon banner interrupts the credential flow before the desktop appears. Citrix pass-through / single sign-on hands credentials to Winlogon, and the banner forces an extra acknowledgement in the ICA session - test SSO with the banner in place before rolling it to the pool. The banner is usually a legal requirement, so treat this as "schedule the test", not "consider dropping it".

Policy Name: 2.3.7.5 Configure 'Interactive logon: Message title for users attempting to log on'
VDI Rationale / Note: See 2.3.7.4 - verify the banner does not break Citrix pass-through/SSO before pool-wide rollout.

VDI Rationale / Note: Public-profile rules only bite if the vNIC is CLASSIFIED Public. On a freshly provisioned VM the Network Location Awareness service can win the race against domain-controller contact and stick the adapter in Public, at which point default-deny inbound plus 9.3.4 blocks the HDX listener (1494/2598) and the session lands on a black screen. Confirm the pool classifies as Domain on first boot before enforcing.

Policy Name: 9.3.4 Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Settings: Apply local firewall rules' is set to 'No'
Category: Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security (formerly Windows Firewall with Advanced Security) - Public Profile
VDI Rationale / Note: The riskiest check in the firewall group for Citrix. Local rule merge OFF means the rules the VDA installer wrote locally are IGNORED in the Public profile. CIS only requires this for Public, so the Domain profile keeps the VDA rules - but a VM that misclassifies as Public (see 9.3.2) loses HDX inbound entirely. Either guarantee Domain classification, or push the VDA port rules from GPO so they survive the merge being off.
